notes: Version 3. Central message: the scan is done; a suitable supervisor isn't on your shift; your logbook shouldn't have to wait. Narration tells the story; 'screen' lists the short on-screen ideas (never the spoken sentence). Accreditation-neutral: no acronyms are spoken (see docs/commercial-2026/13-pronunciation-glossary.md). 'say' is what the voice model reads when it differs from the caption text.

flagship.text: You've completed an ultrasound scan, during a busy night shift.
But the right supervisor isn't always there. They might be working different days, different shifts, or at another hospital.
screen: Your supervisor isn't on your shift.

flagship.text: And before you know it, another week has passed. Your scans shouldn't be forgotten, simply because your rotas don't match.
screen: Your logbook shouldn't have to wait.

flagship.text: Wavelength helps you record each scan while it's fresh. Then arrange the right review, without you both needing to be there at the same time.
flagship.say: Wavelength helps you record each scan, while it's fresh. Then arrange the right review, without you both needing to be there, at the same time.

flagship.text: Open your logbook and choose the scan. Record your findings and how you were supervised, add an image once identifiers are removed, and it can count towards your chosen pathway.
Then choose a supervisor Wavelength has verified. We check their registration where it applies, review their ultrasound credentials, and approve them only for specific areas.
Send your review request in a few taps. It waits on your supervisor's dashboard.
When they're next available, on another shift or at another site, they review each scan, rate the images, add feedback, and sign.
You see the outcome in your logbook, with a code anyone can verify. Directly supervised scans and formal assessments still follow your pathway's rules.
screen: Direct supervision and formal assessments follow your pathway's rules.

flagship.text: Every review moves your training forward, and your evidence stays organised, ready to export for your portfolio.
Recording scans, requesting reviews and tracking your progress are all part of the free logbook.
And when you're ready to build your skills, our hands-on courses and tailored training are here to help.
flagship.say: And when you're ready to build your skills, our hands-on courses, and tailored training, are here to help.

short.text: Scanned on a night shift, but your supervisor works days?
With Wavelength, you log the scan while it's fresh,
send a review request to a verified supervisor,
and they review it when they're next available.
Your scans, your reviews and your progress, all in one place, and it costs nothing to use.

ad.text: Ultrasound training, tailored to your needs, with flexible locations by arrangement.
Hands-on courses and expert-led teaching, for individuals and groups. UK and international enquiries are welcome.
